title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Offer and Rewards Terms: Welcome Discount and Finch Circle Points
content:
Welcome discount and Finch Circle points earn figures of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards, by card. Each column is the Marlowe & Finch card of that name.

| | Store Card | Store Card Plus | Store Card Elite | Mastercard | Platinum Mastercard | World Elite Mastercard |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Welcome discount (percent) | 20 | not applicable | not applicable | 20 | not applicable | 25 |
| Welcome window (calendar days) | 2 | not applicable | not applicable | 2 | not applicable | 2 |
| Welcome discount cap (USD) | 100.00 | not applicable | not applicable | 100.00 | not applicable | 150.00 |
| Bonus points per net dollar at Marlowe & Finch | 1 | 2 | 3 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
| Points per dollar outside Marlowe & Finch | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 1 | 1 | 1.50 |
| Points per dollar at supermarkets and gas stations | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 2 | 2 | 3 |

## Terms of the figures

1. **Welcome discount** — the percent taken off Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to a newly approved account inside the welcome window; not applicable for a card reached by status upgrade.
2. **Welcome window** — the calendar days, counting the approval date as day 1, during which the welcome discount applies.
3. **Welcome discount cap** — the maximum total welcome discount across all purchases in the window.
4. **Bonus points at Marlowe & Finch** — Finch Circle bonus points per net dollar of Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to the card, added on top of the member's base earn.
5. **Points outside Marlowe & Finch** — Finch Circle points per dollar of purchases charged outside Marlowe & Finch; not applicable for a store-only card.
6. **Supermarkets and gas stations** — Finch Circle points per dollar charged at supermarkets and gas stations (Mastercard merchant category codes 5411 and 5541 or 5542).

## Example (hypothetical purchase)

A net Marlowe & Finch purchase of USD 80.00 charged to a Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite earns 3 bonus points per dollar, 240 bonus points on top of the member's base earn. A USD 50.00 supermarket purchase on a Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard earns 3 points per dollar, 150 points.
